scope: All short-form edits. Review each target platform separately; these numbers are the Instagram Reels planning default.
coordinate_basis: Source video pixels; scale proportionally for other export sizes. Conservative editorial envelope, not an official universal UI template.

sources.kind: Meta-authored Reels ads guide hosted on a third-party CDN
sources.finding: Page 4: leave bottom 35% free of key elements. Ad guidance, not a guarantee for every organic Reel.
Reports Meta margins of 14% top, 35% bottom, 6% sides. Meta help URL redirected to login during direct research.
Reports September 2026 screenshot measurements: top200, bottom700, right170. Basis for extra right rail/bottom padding.
Uses looser 220/450/40/140 margins. Not adopted: disagreement illustrates why one PNG is not a universal guarantee.

ui_map.top: Reels title, navigation/camera/status controls; exact layout varies
ui_map.right: Like, comment, share/repost, overflow controls and counts; save can be in overflow or vary with viewing surface. Reserve the entire rail, not fixed icon spots.
ui_map.bottom_left: Avatar, username, follow, description/caption, audio attribution; caption length and expansion vary
ui_map.bottom: Navigation, audio/interaction UI; ads can add a CTA bar

mandatory_rules: Keep all essential diagram nodes, strokes, arrowheads, labels, burned-in captions, faces and calls to action inside the safe rectangle, including their full entrance/movement bounds. Background and decorative texture may bleed.

Center the main visual group on both actual frame axes (540,960 at 1080×1920). Titles may be left-aligned above it. Fit or recompose the visual around this center within the safe envelope; never silently substitute the UI-safe rectangle midpoint.
Use the review overlay before export; never bake it into the delivered video.
If diagram and speech captions compete, alternate beats or simplify; do not shrink text until unreadable.
Check at 360px-wide phone size. Body/diagram labels should be at least 33px in the 1080px source; handwritten annotations need at least 38px before any scaling and must pass a phone-size review.
Review full-screen 9:16 and central 4:5 / 3:4 feed/cover crop stress tests, plus a tall-screen crop. Those are test scenarios, not assertions that every device uses those crops.
Verify the first real footage pilot in the current Instagram preview before publishing, and re-check when UI changes. Preview with the real description length and any native captions enabled.

Do not promise all details visible on every possible screen/state. Expanded captions, comments, accessibility settings and app experiments can obscure content beyond any static safe rectangle. Design for normal collapsed playback and test current target surfaces.
